stories.title: Indicador ZEW de sentimento econômico da zona do euro recua para 25,8 em setembro

en.title: ZEW economic sentiment indicator for eurozone falls to 25.8 in September
en.summary: The ZEW economic sentiment indicator for the eurozone declined to 25.8 in September from August's six-month high of 31.4, falling below analyst expectations of 39.9. Current conditions improved while inflation expectations rose significantly.

stories.title: Indicador ZEW de sentimento econômico da Alemanha sobe para 34,7 em setembro

en.title: German ZEW economic sentiment indicator rises to 34.7 in September
en.summary: Germany's ZEW economic sentiment indicator increased to 34.7 in September 2026, marking its highest level since February, though falling short of market expectations of 37. The reading suggests cautious optimism about recovery in Europe's largest economy, though elevated energy costs and geopolitical uncertainties continue to pose risks.
